title: alnus glutinosa lusus incisa
intro: Alnus glutinosa lusus incisa, commonly known as the Cut-leaved Alder, is a plant species that belongs to the Betulaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of Alnus glutinosa lusus incisa are attributed to its ability to modulate immune response, exhibit anti-proliferative effects, and display hepatoprotective properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
